items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I also knew his first wife very well... I did know Nat King Cole... I just admired his work so much.

ctx.x: Yes, it's a book. It's the autobiography of Nat King Cole, "The Autobiography of Nat King Cole," I think that's the title of the book. However, there was one item in the book that was -- that I'd like to correct right now, and this item involved me, and it was an untrue statement made by Mrs. Cole, that when she went into a certain club -- I don't know if you remember the Beaux Cards -- do you remember the little Beaux Cards Club, used to be above CBS, I think it was on Melrose, if I'm not mistaken. It was a very…
I remember the name, but I can't remember what the club was like.
